verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a transaction-process endpoint that creates a transaction and runs payment screening and transaction monitoring. Payment screening cases exist as an exportable record type, and cases and alerts can be reviewed via the web app or API, with an audit trail per case. However, the evidence never shows a pre-release hold/release decision returned for a payment, nor how payment-specific matches are presented for inspection; the case, alert and decision docs are framed around customer screening. Missing for 10: documented pre-release payment hold/release decision, payment-level match/hit detail inspection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
